authorization: Default deny, signed human identity or tightly scoped website service identity; active current account, password-version binding, explicit exact-scope active finite grant. Legacy role/email/header/operator UID config never grants capabilities. Platform capability does not imply publishing/maintenance. Restricted identity profile persists after revocation/expiry; no fallback to ordinary private-owner access.
grant_management: Human bearer only. News manager may change ONLY read/create/edit/delete on privately verified News staff. Cannot grant platform, maintenance, manage_publishers or seed. Platform administrator manages verified permission subjects. Expected account revision required; deterministic account/state locks, stale409; delegation cannot outlive issuer authority. No HTTP bootstrap/verification of unknown staff.
maintenance: Platform issues approval for exact subject/action/target, <=300seconds and1-10uses. Gate actions target news_write_gate; review targets ONLY public.news_article_id_seq. Subject credential/permission revision and current issuer capability rechecked. Approval revocation supported. Approval consumption, gate transition and SUCCESS audit commit atomically. Existing pause<=60seconds, fail-closed incidents, explicit takeover/reconciliation retained. No SQL/sequence correction endpoint.
seed: Optional separately granted news.seed plus news.create, configured subject and explicit short-lived seed approval. No implicit startup initializer privilege. News identity helper requires a SEED admission. This is not permission for arbitrary SQL or production sequence correction.
service: Existing website-news secret hash/finite expiry/revocation/current publisher credential binding retained. HTTPS except literal synthetic loopback, no redirects. Service credentials cannot act as human grant administrator/maintenance/platform identity. No secret in browser or audit.
schema: P66 -> P63C -> P68G -> p68h5_capabilities: four additional tables app_permission_revision/app_capability_grant/app_authorization_audit/app_maintenance_approval. Total staged new tables15. No role/user/grant backfill. Full column/PK/FK/CHECK validation on repeat. Permission metadata required before candidate deployment, including private owner route checks; missing metadata fails closed.
audit: Durable decision/grant/approval/control records with UUID identifiers, account references, scope/outcome/revision/timestamp. No payload/password/token/secret/contact strings. Deletion removes owned grants/approvals/state and redacts account links in retained audit; no silent loss of adopted ledgers. Failed authentication/control attempts recorded where metadata is available; unavailable audit never enables a protected action.
transition: Inventory from prior P68H-4 is historical:4active admin-role accounts,1website-whitelist eligible. Verify ownership privately, approve exact capabilities/expiry, create empty schema then bootstrap selected existing verified subjects under separately approved operator DB procedure before deployment. No automatic grants from legacy role/whitelist. Dedicated restricted staff identities cannot access personal garage/profile flows; do not reuse vehicle-owner identities without reviewing this intentional restriction. Role values/authentication mechanisms retained.
recovery: Private independently verified recovery administrator with finite platform capability provisioned before rollout. If all grants misconfigured/expired, use separately authorized restricted operator provisioning, not public bypass/email-role fallback. Pre-adoption transactional/guarded unused rollback; after adoption retain all permission revisions/audit/approvals/receipts and use compatible secure code. P68G global-role source is not a least-privilege rollback.
